learning_outcomes.text: Finds an opportunity to develop an application in a business field.
Solves problems with an engineering perspective.
Reinforces their experience in operating systems and software development tools.
Increases their knowledge of computer hardware through applications.

syllabus_topics: Observe hierarchical responsibilities, relationships, organizational structure, and work discipline in workplaces where students will work to reinforce knowledge and experience gained during their education.
Increase knowledge and experience related to diploma programs by observing and performing applications.
Gain the ability to use theoretical knowledge and transfer it to practice.

Develop the habit of working harmoniously with the personnel of the institution where they conduct workplace training and establishing good communication with other related parties (customers or other institutions).
Enable them to recognize and follow technological developments in the sector.
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
